title: Engine: favorites + hidden games store (LibraryCurationStore)
description: One small persistent store for both halves of library curation - favorites and hidden - keyed by the dashboard's stable game id. Hiding is visibility-only (play sessions, launch outcomes, per-game config all preserved). Nothing displays it yet; the next pieces wire it into cards, the detail page, and settings.
commit_message: Add LibraryCurationStore: favorites + hidden games persistence
